description: SLADE only: how the unlabeled batch is drawn and how Eq 7 mining relates to the pseudo labels. The unmodified run is the literal paper reading, with a uniformly shuffled unlabeled batch and Eq 7 thresholding basis similarity alone. There only ~1/k of batch pairs share a cluster, and ~25% of mined positives did. 'pseudo_label_sampler' draws unlabeled_batch_size/4 clusters x 4 members per batch, the m-per-class sampling of the framework the paper builds on. 'pseudo_label_mining_filter' keeps a mined positive only inside a cluster and a mined negative only across clusters. 'pseudo_label_sampler_and_filter' does both. The number of unlabeled steps per epoch is unchanged. Compare mined_positive_precision and mined_positive_same_cluster_fraction in the activity diagnostics alongside the score. The run's unlabeled batch size must be divisible by 4.
name: slade_pseudo_label_sampling
